name: Adobe for Claude
description: Edits images, reviews PDFs, designs from Express templates and cuts video inside Claude, using Adobe's Photoshop, Lightroom, Acrobat and Premiere tools.

skills.name: Edit Video
skills.description: Cuts event footage into highlight reels and resizes clips for Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts.

skills.name: Search Creative Cloud Assets
